condo: View to appreciate! Beautiful Freehold Walk Up - Upper East Coast

history.summary: A freehold walk-up 3BR (1,244 sqft) in Upper East Coast (D15), asking $1.8M ($1,447 psf), listed under a marketing title with no project name or built_year. Freehold D15 near the new Siglap TEL station is genuinely attractive, but it's a no-facility walk-up with no URA data and an unverifiable building.
history.rating_rationale: $1,447 psf for a FH D15 3BR in the desirable Upper East Coast belt, 750m from the new Siglap TEL station, is reasonable and the TEL opening is a real catalyst. But this is a walk-up (no facilities, lift-less, older), the listing hides project name and built_year, and there is no URA series — the 'View to appreciate' framing is marketing. Freehold + location + TEL keep it balanced; the walk-up format and data gaps stop it short of Buy.
